fragments.text: Minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities (MREL) - Calibration
an amount of the losses to be absorbed in resolution that corresponds to the resolution entity’s own funds requirements

a recapitalisation amount that allows the resolution group resulting from resolution to restore compliance with its own funds requirements after the implementation of the preferred resolution strategy.

fragments.section_anchor: Banks continue to meet their MREL targets at year end 2025
fragments.text: MREL aims to ensure that a bank maintains sufficient loss-absorbing capacity to ensure that in resolution its shareholders and creditors would absorb the costs of any failure of the bank.
The minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities (MREL) dashboards are based on bank data reported to the Single Resolution Board (SRB)
